title: Red Day Across Markets as Gold Slides and Bitcoin Retreats
lede: Markets pulled back on Wednesday as investors cut risk across the board. Jakarta's benchmark fell more than 1%, gold lost over 3%, and Bitcoin slid toward $63,000, while market sentiment stayed pinned at extreme fear.

paras: The IHSG closed at 5,247.88, down 1.07% on the day. The decline set the tone for a week that would only get heavier, with the index giving back ground for the first of three straight sessions.

US stocks were mixed but mostly lower. The Dow fell 1.10% and the S&P 500 eased 0.31%, while the Nasdaq 100 bucked the trend with a 0.39% gain. Gold was the day's standout loser, dropping 3.20% as even haven assets were sold.
Bitcoin fell 2.89% to $63,068 and Ether dropped 2.61% to $1,777. The Fear & Greed index read 11 — extreme fear — a level it would hold, give or take a point, for the entire week.
